3.3.2 Primitive Types
Franca IDL has a set of predefined, so called primitive, data types: integers, floats, Boolean values, and strings. Whereas integers, floats, and booleans are covered by the AUTOSAR platform types, strings have to be encoded. In the following we define the application and implementation data types that are generated by the Franca-to-AUTOSAR translation to represent the primitive types of Franca IDL. Both application and implementation types obtain the short names given in [TR_FRANCA_00426].
[TR_FRANCA_00426] Franca primitive types and the corresponding AUTOSAR platform types ⌈ Franca primitive type AUTOSAR short name UInt8 uint8 Int8 sint8 UInt16 uint16 Int16 sint16 UInt32 uint32 Int32 sint32 UInt64 uint64 Int64 sint64 Boolean boolean Float float32 Double float64
